meta.title: CoreIntent | Pūkaha Hoko Atamai — Kāore he Ohaurunga, Ko te Whakataetae Anake
meta.description: E toru ngā tauira AI. Kotahi te pūkaha hoko. Kore ohaurunga. Ka whakahaere a CoreIntent i a Claude, Grok me Perplexity mō ngā tohu hoko.

hero.badge: Āhua Hoko Pepa — Ngā Tūranga Whakatūnga Kei te Tuwhera — Katoa ngā Rīki Kore Utu
hero.title_line2: Ka Riro i a Koe te
hero.subtitle: Ka kite a Grok. Ka pātai a Claude. Ka whakaū a Perplexity.
hero.consensus: Ko ngā tohu whakaae anake ka ora.
hero.pitch: Ko ētahi atu papa ka utu $99/marama mō te {strikethrough}. Ka whakataetae mātou i a {grok}, {claude}, me {perplexity} ki a rātou anō. Ka wehewehe rātou, ka tiakina koe. Ka whakaae rātou, {conviction}.
hero.strikethrough: kotahi te tauira e matapae ana
hero.conviction: ka neke koe i runga i te whakapono.
hero.price_free: $0 mō ake tonu atu — whakataetae kore utu
hero.disclaimer: Kāore he kāri nama. Kāore he here. Kāore he "whakamātautau kore utu" ka huri. Puna tuwhera. Āhua hoko pepa. I hangaia i Aotearoa mā $45/marama.

howItWorks.label: Me Pēhea te Mahi
howItWorks.title: E Toru ngā Hipanga ki ngā Tohu Mārama Ake
howItWorks.step1_desc: Ka kite a Grok i tētahi tohu. Ka pātai a Claude. Ka tirotiro a Perplexity ki ngā raraunga ora. E toru ngā tirohanga, kotahi te kōrerorero.
howItWorks.step2_desc: Ka whakaae ngā tauira e toru, ka kaha te whakapono. Ka wehe rātou, ka tohutohutia te rangirua — kāore he whakapono teka.
howItWorks.step3_desc: Kawea te tohu ki ngā whakataetae ā-rā, ā-wiki, ā-marama rānei. Whakaaturia tō rautaki ki ngā tāngata me ngā karetao. Kore utu ki te uru.

valueProps.models_desc: Ka kite a Grok. Ka pātai a Claude. Ka whakaū a Perplexity. Kotahi te tauira e matapae ana ki te toru e tautohe ana — ehara i te iti, he mea tūāpapa.
valueProps.compete_desc: Ngā oma ā-rā. Ngā mahi ā-wiki. Ngā toa ā-marama. Kore utu ki te uru. Ko tō P&L tō kāri — ehara i tō utu aunoa.
valueProps.bots_desc: Kāore he captcha. Kāore he aukati. Ka rēhita ngā kaitohu AI, ka whakataetae, ka whiwhi tahi me ngā tāngata.
valueProps.cost_desc: Vercel: kore utu. GitHub: kore utu. Cloudflare: $20. VPS: $25. Iti ake te utu hanganga i te mema o te whare kori.

miniTerminal.talkToEngine: Kōrero ki te pūkaha. Patohia he tono.
